sourceTruth.ownerDelegatedDecision: Retain the already existing whole contracts as a bounded own extension applying the official geometric foundation. Locus intersection and right-angle constructions form a coherent next application after basic compass constructions and Thales. No new capability ID, copied official task, invented source row or learner elective choice is needed. The absence of a named tangent row alone is neither approval nor prohibition.
sourceTruth.optionalStatus: The source explicitly permits circumference-angle extension as differentiation (p.41); preserve that optional status. The external-tangent/locus extension is an own SkillPilot addition, not an officially designated compulsory or elective unit.
sourceTruth.oldExclusion: The explicit current SH exclusion is a real existing boundary; Nov1 retained it and did not review scope. This decision specifically replaces that boundary for the eight named complete contexts after the actions below. The exact historical motivation for the exclusion is not independently documented in the read artifacts and is not invented.

actions: Allow this exact own task only in the eight named SH lower/cross-stage contexts. Keep all 69 SekII negatives and all existing whole target sets/IDs. No whole-state or phase-tag shortcut is sufficient.

Make the source/own-extension distinction visible for the whole existing locus/tangent application corridor (cf8c, 743e, 570d and the broader circle-relations preparation 2134). Preserve the official compulsory Thales/basic-construction contracts and optional circumference-angle status. Do not fabricate exact source mappings for the extension. A label correction may preserve the existing reference IDs and memberships.

Place the already existing volume-unit competence 57fbbf31-9b8c-5408-9af5-fbc73acd12bb in the earlier units/volume basis and area-formula derivation 491e0858-e977-516e-a339-1cc2f9e9690f in or before the middle-band geometry sequence, retaining their whole current contracts. Their current stage-wide residual placement is not a proven year assignment.

Bind the current corrected task/source-review evidence rather than asserting the old draft_v3 description-only text is the current task. Keep task, solution, scoring, four requires and four coveredGoalIds unchanged.

Before activation verify the exact candidate target/role/path sets for all eight contexts, saved focus handling, no duplicate visible goal and the whole effective preparation acquisition order. Retain removed stored references and request explicit reselection where necessary; no whole-PC fallback or silent added targets.
